title: Allocation identified set
claim_summary: The union of selected optimal allocations over an explicit admissible primitive and selection class is the information content of a ranking
mechanism_interpretation: Separates ordinal information from cardinal margins, feasible actions, risk law and selection
empirical_link: Score order and acreage order are descriptive observables only

title: Identified-set contraction
claim_summary: Restricting the admissible primitive or selection class can only shrink the allocation identified set; point identification is singleton collapse
mechanism_interpretation: States what additional information can identify
empirical_link: Empirical conditioning can narrow but not prove optimality

title: Risk-feasible exchange rank-preservation certificate
claim_summary: No reversed point is optimal when every reversal admits a feasible risk-feasible transfer toward the higher-ranked higher-margin crop
mechanism_interpretation: Positive sufficient condition for no reversal
empirical_link: Only observable exchange restrictions may receive empirical analogues

title: Restricted winner-take-all top-rank preservation
claim_summary: With only the land simplex, redundant risk and a unique positive top margin, all land goes to the top-ranked crop
mechanism_interpretation: Clean positive anchor; not a full pairwise acreage ranking
empirical_link: Not a claim about farms with unobserved constraints

title: Cardinal margin-gap allocation response
claim_summary: Holding rank and all other primitives fixed, changing cardinal margin gaps may change selected acreage and optimal-face ranges, with null/nonmonotone responses retained
mechanism_interpretation: Isolates the margin channel without asserting global monotonicity
empirical_link: Continuous pre-decision margin gaps may be tested associationally

title: Complete pairwise KKT pressure identity
claim_summary: Margin pressure equals tail-risk, budget, shared-operational and boundary pressure plus a zero numerical residual; the land pressure cancels pairwise
mechanism_interpretation: Local optimality accounting, not acreage causality
empirical_link: Dual terms are model-derived and not observed preferences

title: Operational mechanism trichotomy
claim_summary: Operational restrictions affect reversal through direct feasible-set forcing, marginal dual pressure, or boundary/selection effects; categories can coexist
mechanism_interpretation: Prevents binding frequency from being called causal attribution

title: Risk-limit feasible-set contraction
claim_summary: Tightening kappa nests risk-feasible sets and weakly lowers the optimal value; no crop-specific acreage monotonicity follows
empirical_link: A farmer risk limit remains latent without external identification

title: Selected counterfactual and Shapley efficiency
claim_summary: Path increments telescope and all-subset Shapley allocations sum exactly to the selected full-minus-baseline change
mechanism_interpretation: Acreage attribution is selection- and order-aware
empirical_link: No direct transfer to observed acreage causality

title: Ordered-loss risk contraction
claim_summary: Pointwise CVaR ordering under a proved fixed-marginal named-family loss order nests feasible sets and weakly lowers value
mechanism_interpretation: Dependence can alter risk opportunity sets, not necessarily a coordinate
empirical_link: Scalar tail estimates do not identify the order

title: Diversification outcome vector
claim_summary: Variance diversification, tail diversification, concentration and true-law regret are separate comparator-indexed outcomes
mechanism_interpretation: Replaces one ambiguous diversification label with four falsifiable constructs
empirical_link: Requires synchronized profit outcomes for descriptive analogues

title: Diversification non-equivalence
claim_summary: Lower concentration or variance does not generally imply lower true-law CVaR, feasibility or regret
mechanism_interpretation: Defines diversification failure as a vector of evidence, not a scalar shortcut
empirical_link: Observed crop counts cannot establish welfare

title: True-law regret and violation separation
claim_summary: An assumed-law policy is evaluated by true-law feasibility violation first and nonnegative objective regret only when true-law feasible
empirical_link: Welfare language requires a validated decision model

title: Operational information value and informativeness monotonicity
claim_summary: Information value is nonnegative; zero under a common optimal constant policy; weakly rises with a verified garbling order; informed and uninformed values weakly rise with nested flexibility
mechanism_interpretation: Information matters only through feasible policy change
empirical_link: Requires timestamped signals and actionability measures

title: Conditional information-flexibility complementarity
claim_summary: Joint supermodularity on a verified policy lattice and strong-set-order feasibility imply increasing differences of information value; strictness needs a strict cross-difference
mechanism_interpretation: Preserves complementarity as a restricted positive result
empirical_link: Causal complementarity still requires exogenous variation

title: No general information-flexibility complementarity
claim_summary: The full acreage simplex is not a componentwise lattice and flexibility may add dominated or common robust actions, giving zero or substitution
mechanism_interpretation: Prevents Topkis-style invocation without its domain and payoff conditions
empirical_link: Null and negative interactions must be retained

title: Within-family dependence allocation response
claim_summary: After fixed-marginal family-specific validation, allocation and reversal responses remain numerical outcomes unless a coordinate-order theorem is proved
mechanism_interpretation: Connects conditional risk order to falsifiable allocation evidence
empirical_link: Dependence associations cannot identify farmer CVaR causation

title: Model-linked acreage transitions
claim_summary: Pre-decision score and margin gaps, observable constraints, downside exposure and flexibility may predict later acreage-share transitions under explicit timing and aggregation limits
mechanism_interpretation: Tests consistency with named model channels
empirical_link: Descriptive or associational unless a separate identification design passes
